reference: Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Z51 (C8, 2020-2026): GM LT2 6.2 L naturally aspirated pushrod cross-plane V8, dry sump, with the Z51's NPP valved performance exhaust. Engineering reference only.

interior.source: Car and Driver, 2020 Z51 test, Dec 2019 issue (research S16, S17): 47 dBA idle, 92 dBA full throttle, 74 dBA at 70 mph

exterior.source: EU stationary noise, maker figure quoted by auto motor und sport (S19); test rpm estimated from UN R51.03

notes.sources: Research notes: research_notes/cars/RefC8Stingray.json and .md (source ids S01-S41). Spec sheet: docs/cars/RefC8Stingray.md.
notes.engine.crank: [P] Cross-plane crankshaft, forged steel (S07, S10): even firing every 90 degrees.
notes.engine.banks: [P] GM numbering: odd cylinders 1-3-5-7 on the left (driver's side) bank, even 2-4-6-8 on the right, cylinder 1 at the accessory end (S11). [E] In the C8 the accessory and dry-sump end faces forward, toward the cabin (transaxle behind the engine, oil tank on the block's left-front corner, S07), so each list runs front to back in the car too. Bank sequence along the firing order: L R L R R L R L; the left bank fires at 0/180/450/630 degrees (gaps 180-270-180-90), the right at 90/270/360/540 (180-90-180-270): the uneven pulses of each bank are the cross-plane burble.
notes.engine.idleRpm: [E] Not published; typical Gen V warm idle 550-650 rpm (research note). Matches the car config.
notes.engine.limiterRpm: [P] Fuel-cut 'Engine Overspeed Protection' at about 6,600 rpm in manual mode (S27); GM's torque chart ends at about 6,620 rpm (S12). Matches the car config.
notes.exhaust.evoDeg: [E] Calibrated default. The LT2's exhaust cam has 18 degrees more duration than the LT1's (S07), so the real EVO is a little earlier; a uniform shift doesn't change a steady loop's spectrum.
notes.exhaust.gasTempK: [E] Full-load primary gas temperature of a naturally aspirated V8, as the GT12.
notes.exhaust.pipeTempK: [E] Downstream of the close-coupled catalysts (S07, S25), which keep the gas hot.
notes.exhaust.rasp: [E] A little above the default: reviewers hear it 'thunder like a NASCAR engine' at full throttle (S13).
notes.exhaust.collectors: [P] Upswept 4-into-1 stainless tubular headers with tapered collectors, one per bank (S07, S23); EngineLabs calls them equal-length on performance-exhaust cars (S08). [E] Primary length 0.5 m (compact mid-engine headers) with a 0.02 m spread.
notes.exhaust.merge: [P] No separate X- or H-pipe; owners describe the NPP muffler as nearly straight-through with an internal X-pipe (S25). [E] crossover 0.4 below 500 Hz, in the 0.3-0.5 range docs/AUDIO.md gives for X-pipes; the BMW S65 recording used for calibration showed a crossover near 0.5.
notes.exhaust.outlets: [P] Two close-coupled catalysts, then Tenneco's cold end with one large shielded muffler (S23, S24); quad tips as two pairs, one pair at each outer rear corner (S36 photos). [E] 1.9-1.95 m from collector to tips (a short mid-engine run: cats at the rear bulkhead, transverse muffler over the transaxle); 0.3 m tails. [A] 76 mm (3 in) pipes: the stock size wasn't found, aftermarket cat-backs use 3 in (research note). [E] The right-hand tips are 0.2 m farther from a driver sitting on the left.
notes.exhaust.muffler.valves: [P] The Z51's NPP exhaust adds two tailpipe valves (up to four valves with the AFM valves, S23-S25). Valve modes: Stealth closed, Tour mostly closed, Sport open at idle and in most driving, Track always open (S25, S26). [E] Modelled open: the game plays Sport/Track. Tour's closed-valve cruising and V4 (AFM) mode are not modelled.
notes.exhaust.muffler.openLowpassHz: [E] Nearly straight-through with the valves open (S25), so a little above the default 3,800 Hz.
notes.exhaust.closedLowpassHz: [E] Defaults; unused while the valves are open.
notes.intake.level: [E] A little above the default 0.25: the rear-facing intake and airbox sit right behind the seats in a mid-engine car (S07; docs/AUDIO.md). At 0.35 the evenly spaced intake pulses masked the exhaust's idle burble (measured), so 0.3.
notes.intake.runnerLengthM: [P] Eight equal runners about 210 mm long (S07, S08).
notes.intake.airboxHz: [E] A large plenum fed by an 87 mm throttle (S07, S08): a little below the default 110 Hz.
notes.intake.snorkelLengthM: [E] Duct from the left-side body intake to the airbox, about 0.8 m.
notes.intake.mouthDiameterM: [E] About 0.1 m (the throttle is 87 mm, S07).
notes.mechanical.valvetrain: [E] Calibrated default; pushrods with hydraulic roller lifters, 2 valves per cylinder (S01).
notes.mechanical.injectors: [E] Direct injection at 150 bar (S01): slightly above the calibrated default for the familiar Gen V injector tick at idle.
notes.idle.lope: [E] A trace of lope: the LT2 cam has more duration than the LT1's (S07), and owners compare the Track-mode idle to 'an old school pre cat muscle car' (S26).
notes.overrun.burble: [E] Mild: no factory crackle map is documented and owners call the stock NPP 'not very aggressive even in Track' (S26); about 0.7 pops a second on a high-rpm overrun.
notes.limiter.free: [E] Undocumented. Free revving bounces faster and deeper than in gear.
notes.limiter.load: [E] In gear: a hard cut with a 120 rpm bounce, inside the research's 100-150 rpm suggestion (S27 and research note).
notes.loops.rpmPoints: [E] Idle (600) to the cut (6,600) about 1.31x apart, so playback speed stays within about 15% of each recording.
notes.loudness.interior: [M] Car and Driver's measured cabin levels for the 2020 Z51 (S16; restated in S17): 47 dBA idle and 92 dBA full throttle set the loop gains. The 74 dBA at 70 mph (73 in the Sept 2020 test, S15) is mostly wind and tyres; the engine's modelled share at 70 mph in 8th (about 1,480 rpm, light load) is about 61 dBA. The drive mode of the idle measurement isn't stated.
notes.loudness.exterior: [F] 95 dB(A) EU stationary noise (S19). [E] Test speed 3,750 rpm from UN R51.03 for a 6,450 rpm rated speed (not found on a document). Not used by the gain model.
notes.loudness.loadRangeDb: [E] Calibrated default: closed vs full throttle at the same rpm.
